programme.title: For the Love of Spock
programme.desc: For the Love of Spock is a heartfelt documentary celebrating the life and legacy of Leonard Nimoy and his iconic portrayal of Spock. A must-watch for Star Trek fans and anyone fascinated by the impact of a true pop culture icon.
